_what: Former LINES measured off sheet 1's side view. The line positions are solid; the LINE -> FORMER NUMBER mapping is NOT yet settled and must not be assumed from this file.
method: A former is drawn as two lines ~1/16 in apart (its own thickness); the station is the pair's centre. Found by column darkness on the rotated side-view crop at 300 dpi.
datum: The crop's left edge, at or just ahead of the foremost line. NOT a chosen aircraft datum.

lines.note: nose; edges read 36 px apart where the fuselage curves, not the usual 19, so this centre is the least certain - and A and B may be ONE former rather than two
circled 6's leader points LEFT to this line
circled 7's leader points LEFT to this line

open_question: Which circled former number sits on each lettered line. Two readings have been wrong so far: leader arrows point LEFT in the cockpit area and RIGHT further forward, so no single rule maps number to line, and the nose pair A/B may be one former drawn at an angle rather than two.
do_not_confuse: F1..F6 on this plan are longerons and cockpit structure, NOT formers. F6 is the cockpit floor. The formers are the circled numbers 1-10.
note: Spacings run 0.215 to 2.250 in, so the formers are NOT evenly spaced: frames_at, never frames_every.
